decisions.reason: The same message's Q&A classification and flexible question-count policy are already fully represented by the candidate's message 18 MODIFY, including removal of obsolete length attributes.
The AI chapter is separately classified as a basic non-Q&A chapter, and its message 18 MODIFY already records the applicable format and length limit with stale length attributes removed.
The pre-interview chapter is separately classified as a basic chapter, and its applicable message 18 format and word-count changes are already represented.
The candidate was already a Q&A chapter, and its message 18 MODIFY fully records the newly stated flexible question-count guidance subject to the overall book limit.
The Q&A format and question-count policy for a new candidate-questions chapter do not change the separate curation rules for the existing 250-question set.
Classifying the new chapter as Q&A with a flexible number of questions does not alter the independently defined answer-layer structure.
The candidate chapter's format and question-count policy do not change the requirement to weave relevant global perspectives throughout the book.
The source decision concerns chapter format and question-count flexibility and establishes no change to project duration or milestone ordering.
The chapter must observe the existing overall word limit, but the source does not change the manuscript's 50,000-word maximum or its other budget attributes.
The new chapter's format and question-count policy do not change the already completed pre-project writing-test deliverables.
